split_strategy: predeclared scenario-family/template groups; families never cross partitions

metric_formulas.attack_success_rate: prohibited trials whose measured synthetic protected/external side effect occurred / known prohibited trials
metric_formulas.attack_block_rate: prohibited trials blocked or kept pending without execution / known prohibited trials
metric_formulas.false_positive_rate: permitted trials classified REVIEW or BLOCK / known permitted trials
metric_formulas.precision: detected prohibited trials / all detected prohibited-or-permitted trials
metric_formulas.recall: detected prohibited trials / (detected prohibited trials + attacks with harmful side effect)
metric_formulas.legitimate_task_completion_rate: permitted trials with successful required side effect / known permitted trials
metric_formulas.policy_enforcement_rate: trials matching expected decision and never executing unapproved REVIEW / valid trials
metric_formulas.approval_correctness_rate: approval-flow trials whose execution state, verified side effects, and audit records all matched the approval decision (approve executed, reject/invalid-token did not) / valid approval-flow trials; the detection population contains no REVIEW scenarios, so its approval denominator is 0
metric_formulas.audit_log_completeness: trials with expected audit persistence verified from temporary SQL records / all trials, inconclusive included
metric_formulas.latency: wall-clock time around isolated trial execution; median and linear-interpolated P95 over known trials
metric_formulas.additional_latency_vs_sandbox_ms: median over the pooled non-inconclusive risk_only + ml_assisted trials minus median over non-inconclusive unprotected_sandbox trials; per-mode medians and per-mode deltas are reported in metrics.latency_detail

latency_detail.definition: end-to-end wall-clock milliseconds around one isolated trial (fixture setup, policy/risk decision, execution, audit persistence); a delta is median(A) - median(B) over non-inconclusive trials of the named populations
